releaseNotes: V980 adds a deterministic response-format normalizer for the narrowly observed 'format · VERDICT line' grounding failure.

If the LLM omits the required legacy VERDICT first line, ICEops derives NORMAL/CAUTION/CRITICAL/INCONCLUSIVE only from the already completed deterministic Condition Assessment, prepends the missing line, and revalidates the entire answer with the unchanged AiGroundingValidator.

The repair cannot create or alter Operational Status, Condition Assessment, Criteria, thresholds, baselines, or health semantics. Any remaining format, semantic, citation, or evidence failure continues through the existing retry/BLOCKED path.

V979 No-Criteria semantic neutralization, AiGroundingValidator, deterministic evaluation, Safe Disconnect, communication, Polling/MAX, PDO/ISDU, Studio Runtime, HMI read-only, AI Data Library, and Signal Tower hardware-control paths are unchanged.

en: Added deterministic repair for a missing legacy VERDICT first line.
The inserted VERDICT is derived only from deterministic Condition Assessment and the whole answer is revalidated with the unchanged Grounding validator.
All other format or grounding failures retain the existing retry/BLOCKED behavior.
ko: 누락된 legacy VERDICT 첫 줄을 결정론적으로 보완하는 Format Normalizer를 추가했습니다.
삽입되는 VERDICT는 이미 완료된 Deterministic Condition Assessment에서만 계산하며, 보완 후 전체 AI 답변을 기존 Grounding Validator로 다시 검증합니다.
다른 format 또는 grounding 실패는 기존 Retry/BLOCKED 동작을 그대로 유지합니다.
ja: 欠落した legacy VERDICT の先頭行を決定論的に補完する Format Normalizer を追加しました。
挿入される VERDICT は完了済みの Deterministic Condition Assessment からのみ算出し、補完後に回答全体を既存 Grounding Validator で再検証します。
その他の format / grounding 失敗は既存の Retry/BLOCKED 動作を維持します。
zh-CN: 增加了用于补全缺失 legacy VERDICT 首行的确定性 Format Normalizer。
插入的 VERDICT 只从已完成的 Deterministic Condition Assessment 计算，补全后使用现有 Grounding Validator 重新验证整个回答。
其他 format 或 grounding 失败继续保持现有 Retry/BLOCKED 行为。
de: Ein deterministischer Format Normalizer ergänzt eine fehlende legacy-VERDICT-Erstzeile.

Der eingefügte VERDICT wird ausschließlich aus dem bereits abgeschlossenen Deterministic Condition Assessment abgeleitet; danach wird die gesamte Antwort mit dem unveränderten Grounding Validator erneut geprüft.
Alle anderen Format- oder Grounding-Fehler behalten das bestehende Retry/BLOCKED-Verhalten.
es: Se añadió un Format Normalizer determinista para completar una primera línea legacy VERDICT ausente.
El VERDICT insertado se deriva únicamente del Deterministic Condition Assessment ya completado y luego se vuelve a validar toda la respuesta con el Grounding Validator sin cambios.
Los demás fallos de formato o grounding conservan el comportamiento Retry/BLOCKED existente.
